sloka: न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्यः सौमित्रे मैथिलीं प्रति ।दृष्टमेतत्पुरा विप्रैः पितुस्ते लक्ष्मणाग्रतः ।। ७.५०.१० ॥
transliteration: na santāpastvayā kāryaḥ saumitre maithilīṁ prati ।dṛṣṭametatpurā vipraiḥ pituste lakṣmaṇāgrataḥ ।। 7.50.10 ॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, you should not feel sorrow regarding Sita, for this very event was foretold long ago by sages in the presence of your father.
